method: Deterministic bounded sampling, exact source winding mass screening, 64-row openness screening, local neighbours, and 128/256/512-row final evaluation.
rank: Within both tolerances first; then (openness error / openness tolerance)^2 + (mass error / mass tolerance)^2; deterministic parameter tie-break.
claim: Nearest among evaluated configurations; no claim of exhaustive search, global optimum or structural safety.
